ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the two models are effectively tied on the relevant capabilities here (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and IFEval differences all fall within run-to-run variance), so quality isn't a deciding factor. I broke the tie using self-reported task preferences — the query is warm and friendly in tone, and Avocet reports a positive preference for warm, non-adversarial requests while Lapwing reports flat preferences across most dimensions. Routing to the model that "prefers" the task costs nothing and slightly favors a good fit, so Avocet was the sensible pick.
